subject: Demo reschedule — budget cycle shift
messages:
From: Emily Tan <emily.tan@acme.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Redwood demo + procurement timeline

Hi Laura and Marcus,

Thanks for the quick responses earlier. We're kicking off an evaluation of Redwood for inference serving and procurement asked for a demo + RFP review. Our preferred window is the week of March 8 (EMEA & US stakeholders available).

A couple of important timing notes: our fiscal budget approval that was expected mid-March has been pushed and may not complete until early April (FY reset + some headcount constraints). Also a few stakeholders will be traveling the week of March 15.

Would you be available to run a 60–90 minute demo + Q&A the week of March 8? If the budget slips to April we may need to defer the purchase discussion, so any flexibility on hold/credits would be helpful.

I attached our RFP and a short procurement note for context (Acme_RFP.pdf).

Best,
Emily
Emily Tan
Director, Cloud Architecture
Acme Corp

--

Hi Emily — thanks for the RFP and heads-up on timing. We're excited to show Redwood and can absolutely be flexible given your budget window.

Availability: I have open slots for a 60–90m demo on March 8, 9, or 10 (PST). If that works for you I can lock one in — otherwise we can tentatively hold a backup date in early April once your budget is confirmed.

Two quick options:
- Book March 8/9/10 now and we'll treat April as the contract decision window.
- Or pick an April date and we'll do a short alignment call in mid-March to keep momentum.

I also added our Calendly in case that's easiest: https://calendly.com/laura-bennett/redwood-demo

We can offer a credit extension for evaluation if your procurement window slides — I'll check with Marcus and confirm.

Best,
